description: Defines the LeaveDecorator class which provides methods to enhance Leave entity with additional logic such as setting related entities, formatting status and date fields, and retrieving latest comments. It uses multiple traits and interfaces with repositories.

classes.name: LeaveDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for Leave entity, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve detailed leave information, format status and date fields, and fetch related comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveDecorator with a specific Leave entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the leave by employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type associated with the leave by leave type ID.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the formatted leave status string (e.g., 'Pending Approval').

methods.name: getLeaveStatusName
methods.description: Returns the internal leave status name in uppercase (e.g., 'PENDING APPROVAL').

methods.name: getLeaveDate
methods.description: Returns the leave date formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getLeaveDuration
methods.description: Returns the leave duration description if available.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of leave in 'H:i' format if duration type specifies time.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of leave in 'H:i' format if duration type specifies time.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Returns the most recent LeaveComment associated with the leave.
